properties.name: Cascadia bioregion (US portion, approximate)
properties.source: Hand-simplified from David McCloskey (Cascadia Institute) published maps and the Cascadia Department of Bioregion. Placeholder until the official shapefile lands via partnership (companion Task 10). US-side only for now; the shape follows the Pacific coast on the west, the US-Canada border on the north, and roughly the continental divide on the east.
properties.note: Marked approximate:true on purpose. Swap this Feature's geometry for the canonical McCloskey shape when it arrives. Do not treat these vertices as authoritative.
